findings.observation: caller-owned mappings survive authorization or schema validation and are consumed later after mutation; reproduced for ToolCall.params, ObservationEvent.measurements and TaskEvent.attributes
findings.impact: authorized values and privacy-bounded telemetry can diverge from values executed or retained
findings.remediation: deep immutable snapshot before validation and consume exactly that snapshot
findings.verification: async/nested mutation regression tests plus full gate and exact-SHA CI

findings.observation: AST detector misses docstring plus pass and bare raise NotImplementedError
findings.impact: documented implementation stubs can pass the blocking AST step
findings.remediation: strip an initial docstring and recognize Name and Call forms
findings.verification: CLI negative tests for every form plus implemented-function control

findings.observation: proposed product documents now reside in candidates and are linked from future milestones
findings.verification: current paths, inbound milestone links, documentation gate and exact-SHA CI

findings.observation: all aggregate, diff, named-module and coverage.py floors can be lowered to zero in pyproject.toml while change-scope and selected policy tests remain green
findings.impact: a quality-policy change can silently remove the principal coverage guarantees
findings.remediation: add a base/head non-decreasing ratchet or an explicit separately reviewed exception record
findings.verification: repeat the weakening probe; the gate must fail before tests execute
